title: England's youngest starter v Rooney and Owen at the same age
checked: England's next match: Croatia at Wembley, 12 Nov 2026 (Sportsdigest + England results page). Youngest starter in the last England XI (6 Oct 2026 v Czechia): Lewis-Skelly, born 26 Sep 2006 (101 Great Goals + All Football line-ups) = 20 years 47 days on 12 Nov. Lewis-Skelly: 10 caps, 1 goal to 6 Oct 2026, scored on his debut v Albania, 21 Mar 2025 (Wikipedia). Rooney reached 20y47d on 10 Dec 2005: 28 caps, 11 goals; goals after 10 caps = 3 (Wikipedia goals list with cap numbers). Owen reached it on 30 Jan 2000: 5 England goals (Morocco, Romania, Argentina 1998; Luxembourg Oct 1998 and Sep 1999 per Sporcle list + Wikipedia), debut 11 Feb 1998 aged 18y59d (Wikipedia). Owen's cap count at that date not confirmed, so not used. Minutes not confirmable, so the twist uses caps.

lines.text: When England play Croatia at Wembley on the twelfth of November, their youngest starter last time out will be twenty years and forty-seven days old.
Myles Lewis-Skelly. He scored on his England debut, against Albania, aged eighteen.
So far: ten caps, one goal, and a Premier League title with Arsenal.
Now the legends at exactly the same age. Wayne Rooney, December twenty oh-five.
Twenty-eight caps and eleven goals. Already a Euro twenty oh-four star.
Michael Owen, January two thousand. Five England goals, including that one against Argentina at the World Cup.

scene.note: Owen's solo goal; Argentina win on pens

lines.text: So on goals, it's Rooney eleven, Owen five, Lewis-Skelly one.
But that's not fair. Rooney and Owen were strikers. Lewis-Skelly is a full-back.
So match the games. After ten caps, Rooney had three England goals. Lewis-Skelly has one, from left-back.
And here's one Rooney and Owen never did. Neither scored on his England debut.

scene.heading: DEBUT DAY
scene.body: Owen v Chile, 1998: no goal. Rooney v Australia, 2003: no goal. Lewis-Skelly v Albania, 2025: scores.

lines.text: So which twenty-year-old would you pick for England? Tell me in the comments.

scene.text: I'm not here to score. But I will.
